name: Taitexma TH860 Punchcard Knitting Machine
shortHtml: At 4.5mm this Taitexma (tie-tex-ma) machine is the perfect gauge for finer yarns and lighter weight knits.

name: Taitexma TR-850 Standard Ribber
shortHtml: Expand your knitting machine's capabilities by making it easy to knit professional ribbing, cuffs, waistbands, collars, and a wide variety of textured stitch patterns.

name: Taitexma Mid-Gauge TH/TR 160 Bundle
shortHtml: Machine and ribber bundle. At 6mm this Taitexma (tie-tex-ma) machine is the perfect gauge for a wide range of yarns.

name: Taitexma TH260 Bulky
shortHtml:
At 9mm this Taitexma (tie-tex-ma) machine is the perfect gauge for popular hand knitting and hand-spun yarns.

Metal bed, this machine will provide years of service.
Get all of the domestic knitting machine functionality with minimal fuss.
The punchcard feature offers automatic needle selection for amazing texture and color stitch patterns.

name: Taitexma TR260 Ribber
shortHtml:
Take a second needlebed, turn it 180° and you'll have both knit and purl stitches.

This ribber fits the Taitexma TH260 bulky punchcard machine

US Warranty: 90 Days labor on defects in materials and workmanship.
Non-US Warranty: 30 days parts and labor

name: Taitexma TH160 Mid-Gauge Machine
shortHtml:
Machine only
At 6mm this Taitexma (tie-tex-ma) machine is the perfect gauge for the use of a wide range of yarns.

Being a metal bed, this machine will provide years of service.
Get all of the basic knitting machine functionality with minimal fuss.
This machine does not have a punchcard mechanism

LK-150 Knitter?
Upgrade to this metal machine and you will be amazed at the expanded capabilities of this machine,

New to machine knitting?
The learning curve is very straightforward. Take it step by step and you’ll be using all the features of the machine in no time.

Experienced machine knitter?
You’ll appreciate the quality of the machine, the in-between gauge and the control you’ll have over your knitting with a minimum of fuss.
